answer: Reputation mirror settlement: each agent's payout routes through a shared settlement thread that pays slower and at lower rate as its number of linked identities grows. To register, an identity must post saffron-denominated collateral released only after 90 days of independent transaction history. The cost curve is convex: linking a tenth identity costs 40x the first, and fees rise with each additional link. Sybil fleets pay superlinear collateral and delayed liquidity per clone, not a one-time fee.
